statement: Exact Run 102→104 comparison preserves twelve scheduled, released, completed, and on-time lots plus 88 delivered devices, but the five-second cadence does not complete the twelfth burn-in batch. Average WIP rises from 49.1905 to 49.6905 DRAM-device-equivalents, mean lot cycle time rises by 1.25 seconds, mean release delay rises by 4.25 seconds, CONWIP control-blocked release time rises by 51 seconds, and Objective score regresses by 0.791667. The unchanged burn-in/customer tail and unchanged leading input-starvation evidence show that earlier external availability is absorbed by admission and queue waiting rather than back-end throughput.
